description: AGSC-01-41: the files and clusters that the domain object names must exist. Derivation over the minimal fixture with its configuration replaced by one that adds domain.vocabulary naming domain/missing.ttl, a file the Bundle does not hold, and domain.contexts declaring a context for the cluster ghost, which no cluster item of the Bundle is. The vocabulary file that cannot be read is AGSC-E901 (an input a verb requires and cannot open, AGSC-01-01) and the context for a cluster that is not there is AGSC-E301 (an unresolved slug); both are errors, so exit 1. The state of the rest of the fixture is unchanged.
